card.name: Linking words before glaucoma or agitation terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with" and "of" just before an eye-pressure or mental-state term like glaucoma, reference delusions or agitation. Also fires on a few word starts inside terms such as anxiety, dextrose and miosis.
